manifest.name: steady-state-single-track-per-platform
manifest.notes: Steady-state bicycle: yr = v*tan(g*delta_road + d0) / (L + K*v^2). Per-platform (L,K,d0,gain) fit via Levenberg-Marquardt on route-grouped train split of data/sim/segments. Truth column is psi_dot_rads for TESLA_MODEL_3, yaw_rate_meas_rads otherwise.
